purpose: Presentation product photos for the ScanSpace catalog

assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: square ecommerce product photo for the ScanSpace hardware-store presentation catalog.
Primary request: A single realistic closed 4 liter interior paint can in Warm white.
Scene/backdrop: seamless pale neutral gray (#f5f5f7) studio backdrop and ground.
Subject: cylindrical metal paint can, silver closed lid and rim, slender metal wire handle folded to the side, a clean ivory paper label with a broad Warm white color band close to #eee8dd. No open paint and no surrounding props.
Style/medium: photorealistic professional product photography with realistic metal and paper texture, soft diffused studio lighting and a gentle grounding shadow.
Composition/framing: one can centered, slight three-quarter view with the lid visible, the full silhouette visible, fills about 70% of a square frame, generous clear margins for ecommerce cropping.
Text (verbatim): Label typography is simple dark sans serif. Only these words: "ScanSpace", "INTERIOR PAINT", "WARM WHITE", "4 L".
Constraints: no finish label because Matte, Eggshell and Satin variants share this color photo. No extra brands, slogans, badges, watermark, hands, plants, brushes, wall scenes or text outside the can. This is a product image, not a website screenshot.
